sources.title: VAT Acts register; English 2012 text listed as draft
VAT SRO register including June 2026 amendments

regimes.name: Standard VAT research candidate
regimes.applicability: Taxable domestic supplies/imports if the standard regime applies.
conditions: Rate appears in NBR FAQ; the page also contains stale law and threshold text.
Verify current registration, product/service code, SRO and input-credit eligibility.

regimes.name: Zero-rated export research candidate
conditions: Keep zero-rated taxable supplies distinct from exempt supplies.
Confirm export evidence, current statutory conditions and input-credit rules.

regimes.name: VAT exemption classification
regimes.applicability: Supply/import covered by an applicable exemption schedule or SRO.
conditions: No blanket pharmacy, food or club exemption.
Document the current instrument and restrictions on related input recovery.

regimes.name: Turnover-tax eligibility review
regimes.applicability: Potential alternative small-business regime; eligibility and rate unresolved.
conditions: Do not use the FAQ's historical thresholds/rate.
Do not combine turnover-tax and ordinary VAT treatment without a reviewed rule.

regimes.name: Supplementary-duty classification
regimes.applicability: Specified goods/services only; not a universal surcharge.
conditions: Review product/service code, duty base, rate, stage and amendments.

regimes.name: Business or company income-tax review
regimes.applicability: Entity/year-specific income tax; never a checkout tax.
conditions: Confirm legal form, assessment year and enacted amendments.
Withholding and advance income tax require separate treatment and reconciliation.

classification_questions: Which charges are meals, takeaway goods, catering, delivery, alcohol, tips or service charges?
How are discounts, deposits, vouchers and refunds treated at the relevant tax point?
Which current NBR restaurant/catering service code, rate and supplementary-duty conditions apply?
Which receipts are subscriptions, joining fees, donations, facility hire, food or admissions?
What is the club's legal form and which activities are commercial supplies?
Are subscriptions, entertainment and restaurant sales governed by different service codes?
Which individual products are medicines, medical devices, supplements or cosmetics?
Does the business also provide clinical services, manufacture goods or import them?
Which medicine/product stage and exemption or reduced-rate SRO applies to each SKU?
Does the business act as principal, agent, importer, exporter or manufacturer?
Which tariff/product codes and documentary evidence support each treatment?
Which current trading-stage regime and input-credit restrictions apply?
Are sales on own account, consignment or commission, and is there a manufacturer appointment?
How are rebates, returns, free stock and cross-border transactions documented?
Do distributor commissions and goods sales require different classifications?
Which SKU classifications apply to the actual product mix?
Are there bundled goods/services, gift vouchers, used goods or imports?
Does the selected retail class require ordinary VAT, a special rate or turnover-tax enlistment?
Are parts, labor, consumables, subcontract work and warranties separately supplied or bundled?
Does the workshop repair, manufacture, import or export goods?
Which service code covers repair labor and how are separately sold parts taxed?

open_questions: The NBR FAQ includes prospective 2017 commencement language, 2015-2016 reduced rates and historical thresholds. None establishes current small-business or industry liability.
Resolve the enacted Finance Act/Ordinance and all applicable 2025-2026 SRO amendments in authoritative Bangla; the listed English draft is not controlling law.
Confirm registration/enlistment thresholds, mandatory-registration categories, input-credit restrictions and VAT withholding before activation.
Industry rates, supplementary duty, medicine-stage exemptions and effective dates remain unverified; no default zero-tax fallback is permitted.
